rows.business_description:
Curtis + Ginsberg Architects LLP (C+GA) is an award-winning architecture and planning firm whose work focuses on serving the needs of our clients, the community, and the environment. The firm was founded in 1990 by Roberta Darby Curtis, AIA, and Mark Ginsberg, FAIA, LEED AP, on the belief that everyone deserves access to quality design and that design can effect positive change for individuals and communities. C+GA is a certified women-owned business (WBE).

Whether the project is a new building, a rehabilitation, or a planning study, C+GA helps each client realize a design that enables them to serve their mission. We are committed to ensuring that each project serves its immediate users and its surrounding community. 

C+GA has completed a wide range of residential, commercial, academic, and cultural projects for public, private, and not-for-profit organizations. The firm is a recognized expert in the design of sustainable mixed-use, multifamily and supportive housing and institutional projects. Our expertise in new construction and the rehabilitation of existing buildings has resulted in the completion of over 25,500 individual units in New York, with approximately 1,800 new and the transformation of 3,000 existing units currently in various stages of design. Central to this work is a belief that people deserve to live, work, and play in well-designed, dignified, and comfortable spaces. 

Our thoughtful design process places special emphasis on analyzing the client’s goals site, program, and budget, to create a design solution that serves the needs of the client and the project’s users, while also considering the broader community and environmental impact. Each project begins with a conversation that continues throughout the design process. We listen carefully to the client and stakeholders to understand their priorities and concerns to create the best possible project. We avidly pursue design excellence, and our work reflects our commitment to quality.

Central to all our work is a commitment to developing social and environmental resilience in the communities in which we work. C+GA has been pivotal in designing for sustainability and resiliency since its founding, not just in green design but also developing enduring schemes that strengthen communities and neighborhoods. Our research and technical expertise in this area is carried through to all our work, whether certified or not. We have completed numerous LEED projects, over 60 buildings in the Enterprise Green Communities program, and are a leader in Passive House (PHIUS and iPHA) certified design, with over 25 Passive House projects in New York City. Our leadership in sustainable design is recognized locally and nationally, ranking in the Engineering News-Record’s (ENR) 2024 Top 100 Green Design Firms, and we were selected for the 2021 Ivory Prize Innovation in Sustainable Housing. In addition, we have taken a lead role in the architecture community’s resiliency efforts following Hurricane Sandy, working with municipalities, public agencies, developers, and civic groups to build more resilient communities. 

The C+GA team is structured to ensure that each client receives the most professional and personalized service possible. Our collaborative and communication-forward ethos strives to advance design excellence while advancing social and environmental resilience.

rows.business_description:
Founded in 1992, Artech provides comprehensive Workforce Solutions including Contingent Staffing, SOW-Project Based Services, Recruitment Process Outsourcing, and NOC Services & Support.  Artech has an estimated $920M annual revenue run rate for 2024 and approximately 11,500 employees and consultants across the U.S., Canada, India, and the Philippines.    

Artech is a minority- and women-owned business enterprise (MWBE) and is ranked the #1 largest women-owned IT staffing firm in the US and the #11 largest IT staffing firm in the US by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA).  The company is very active in the diversity community and its president, Ranjini Poddar, has served on the WBENC Board of Directors and was the WBE Co-chair for the WBENC National Conference in 2009 and again in 2013. Artech is an NMSDC Corporate Plus® member and won the prestigious NMSDC National Supplier of the Year award in 2009 – this is the highest honor a minority supplier can receive.  Artech is also certified by the Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC), and the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC).  

As the largest woman-owned IT Staffing firm in the United States, Artech is committed, both in practice and in principle, to helping underrepresented populations of workers explore and expand their careers in Information Technology and other STEM disciplines. As a supplier, Artech provides a platform for diversity spend that goes beyond our certification as both Woman and Minority owned.  While diverse supply chain initiatives help meet both internal diversity spend initiatives, Artech focuses on the gains that can be made in actual worker participation rates. 

Artech currently employs over 6,400 contractors coast-to-coast across the U.S., supporting more than 85 Fortune 500 and government clients.  Artech’s global headquarters is in located Morristown, NJ, and the firm maintains a strategic presence up and down the eastern seaboard in Massachusetts, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Virginia, North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida.  In the Midwest and Southwest, Artech has several offices in major metropolitan areas such as Chicago, Minneapolis, Dallas, and Phoenix.  On the West Coast, Artech is strongly represented by five offices / service delivery centers in California, Arizona and Washington.

Artech has extensive staff augmentation experience in both IT and non-IT categories.  Artech provides a variety of workforce solutions to meet the needs of its clients in support of job categories such as Information Technology (IT); Engineering; Professional and Managerial; Scientific, Clinical and regulatory; HR; Legal; Sales and Marketing; Design; and Finance and Accounting.   

Artech supports a variety of commercial and government clients, including over 85 Fortune 500 and Global 500 clients worldwide.  Besides its leadership in staff augmentation services in areas such as IT, Professional and Engineering, Artech also specializes in supporting such niche areas as big data, business intelligence and data warehousing, cloud computing, mobility, and ERP solutions for clients such as IBM, Intel, Accenture, Wells Fargo, Google, Best Buy, Expedia, Capital One, DXC Technology, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and others.

All Artech services are supported by a holistic workflow methodology that ties together its dedicated team structure and single point of contact, mature recruiting process, and cutting-edge tools (people, processes and technology) to generate one continuous workflow stream.

Over the last 32 years, Artech has grown every year because of its strong belief in investments into new and innovative technology platforms, human capital, process driven operations management, and conservative financial policies. Artech’s social investments include long term support to programs including advancement of Women in STEM, child education and funding of various autoimmunity based medical research initiatives in partnership with leading institutions such as Yale Medicine and Hackensack University Medical Center.

We have expertise in the management and implementation of MD Active Directory and Desktop Remediation Program.
We  continue to bring the industry’s best and brightest people, processes and technology. Our firm has all the skillsets to assemble and deliver the most practical solutions that will seamlessly integrate with current and legacy systems.  Our capabilities include: 
• Accelerating application innovations.
• Rapid delivery, on-time and on-budget.
• Innovative testing techniques for the highest quality possible.
• Cloud expertise, backed by Google, Azure and/or AWS.

• AI-enabled automation to drive efficiency, productivity and quality.
• The most powerful visualization techniques to enable swift analysis and decision-making.
Protek offers experts in traditional Waterfall and Agile Project Management principles and practices to deliver the project, no matter the scale. Our unwavering view of our clients as long-term partners results in 100% client retention. Fundamental in our achievement of this, is our ongoing relationship with strong partners, including Google, one of the most innovative organizations of all time. Being an official Google Cloud Platform Service Partner means Google has publicly recognized our work implementing solutions like massive data storage, parallel and auto-scaling computing, mobile apps and backends, and many other massive-scale solutions for our clients. In addition, the Protek Team has completed over 100 projects for public sector clients, which consisted of on-premises systems, cloud-based services and hybrid solutions.   
Specifically, in the area of Transportation, we have created a hyperscaled, microservice-based transaction engine that can process current NY E-ZPass files plaza through a validation, rules engine and payment posting pipeline. Using the simplest configuration, the system can process a file with 500,000 transactions in about 90 seconds. This can be scaled further as necessary or can be elastic to accommodate spikes in load in real-time without loss of performance.  The system can handle batch files to accommodate legacy plazas like NY as well as support singular transactions from newer plazas, such as SunPass. We had originally built it to be Cloud agnostic but have since ported it to GCP to use more native services, including GKE, pub/sub, memorystore, FireStore, among others.  
As a Microsoft partner , our Cloud practice has been helping Enterprises and Government organizations adopt modern technologies to scale, secure and innovate new services for years. Our Technical resources are industry thought leaders with real insight to the challenges of today’s largest organizations and understand how technology can make an impact every day. We delivered many MS projects in the city and state which includes desktop planning, image engineering, and remediation following Microsoft’s Desktop Optimization engagement methodology.  
We help design secure, scalable infrastructure and applications that can meet the demand of a robust, complex IT environment and understand that it takes niche resources to proficiently execute Cloud deployments. We have the capabilities to support your Cloud environment on a 24x7x365 basis with teams of resources that understand security, networking, optimizing and patching workloads.

• Custom cloud-native applications development
• Custom document management solutions (SharePoint etc.), 
• Development of solutions using cloud learning and advanced analytics 
• Development of Work Order System using SharePoint & MS Project
• Developing custom software enterprise systems (java, .Net and Mobile). 
Likewise, we have solution for Cloud infrastructure services for:
• Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) implementation and migration 
• DevOps automation 
• Service performance monitoring & reporting in various layers of Cyber Security to Application Monitoring using Dynatrace we have this solution working across NYC and NY State Agencies
• Capacity assessment and improvement 
• Application and database management and migration to cloud services (Oracle to MS SQL etc.).

QualCode, Inc. is a nationally recognized Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Revenue Integrity services firm specializing in complex medical coding, DRG validation, coding compliance, and clinical documentation integrity. Founded in 1999, QualCode has supported hospitals, health systems, physician groups, and healthcare organizations across the United States for over 25 years, delivering precision-driven solutions that protect revenue, reduce regulatory risk, and improve documentation and coding accuracy.

QualCode is a certified Minority Woman-Owned Business Enterprise (MWBE) and operates with a 100% U.S.-based workforce of AAPC- and AHIMA-credentialed professionals. The company’s operating model is built around clinical credibility, audit defensibility, scalability, and operational accountability.

Core Services

QualCode provides end-to-end revenue integrity and coding services across the inpatient, outpatient, and professional fee environments, including:

Inpatient & Outpatient Coding and DRG Validation

MS-DRG and APR-DRG validation

Complex surgical case review

Severity of illness (SOI) and risk of mortality (ROM) optimization

Medical necessity and level-of-care validation

Focused reviews for denials prevention and appeal support

Professional Fee (Pro-Fee) Coding

Multi-specialty E/M coding

Surgical and procedural coding

Provider documentation integrity support

EMR-integrated workflows (Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth, and others)

Coding Compliance & Quality Auditing

Internal and external coding audits

Ongoing quality monitoring programs

Provider and coder feedback loops

Regulatory risk exposure analysis

Audit-ready reporting and defensible documentation

Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) & Revenue Integrity

MEAT criteria validation

Clinical validation reviews

Documentation improvement programs

Denials trend analysis and root cause remediation

Education and process improvement initiatives

Denials Management & Revenue Recovery Support

Clinical and coding-based denials analysis

Appeal support and second-level reviews

Process redesign to prevent future denials

Technology-Enabled Delivery

QualCode operates its services through a proprietary workflow and analytics platform, QCTracker™, which provides real-time visibility into productivity, quality, turnaround time, risk trends, and financial impact. QCTracker supports:

Production and quality management

Audit tracking and outcomes reporting

Trend analysis and risk prioritization

Client-ready executive dashboards

Workforce accountability and performance governance

This technology-enabled approach ensures scalability, transparency, and defensibility across all engagements.

Differentiation

QualCode is not a staffing firm and not a commodity coding vendor. The company differentiates itself through:

A revenue integrity and risk mitigation mindset, not just code assignment

Deep specialization in high-complexity and high-risk case types

A quality-first operating model with continuous audit and feedback loops

Fully domestic, credentialed workforce

Proven ability to integrate quickly into client EMR and operational environments

Defensible, audit-ready processes designed for compliance, not just throughput

A track record of measurable financial and compliance impact

Client Profile

QualCode serves:

Academic medical centers

Large integrated delivery networks (IDNs)

Community hospitals and regional health systems

Specialty hospitals and facilities

Physician groups and professional billing organizations

Engagements range from targeted DRG validation programs to full-scale coding, auditing, and revenue integrity support across enterprise environments.

Operating Philosophy

QualCode’s operating philosophy is simple: if it is not documented, measured, and defensible, it does not scale and it does not survive an audit. The firm designs every engagement around:

Accuracy

Compliance

Transparency

Accountability

Financial and clinical credibility

Corporate Profile

Workforce: 100% U.S.-based, credentialed professionals

Service Area: Nationwide

Specialization: Revenue Integrity, Coding, Compliance, DRG Validation, CDI, Denials Prevention

Summary

QualCode is a mature, proven, and highly specialized revenue integrity partner for healthcare organizations that cannot afford compliance risk, documentation gaps, or preventable revenue leakage. The company exists to protect the clinical and financial integrity of the medical record while enabling healthcare organizations to operate with confidence in an increasingly complex regulatory and reimbursement environment.

Studio Joseph is an architectural firm. We work in different realms of the profession, from public work to cultural projects, free-standing buildings, and interior design. The studio has expertise in welcome centers and community education with museums and libraries. The majority of our work is on the east coast in Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, and Washington, DC.

We begin each project with a “Visioning” session to set expectations, review the budget, and test the viability of the schedule. Studio Joseph has received tremendous recognition in the trade, including awards from the American Institute of Architects, Society of American Registered Architects, Society of Experiential Graphic Designers, Chicago Atheneum awards programs, and others. rows.business_description:
DOSE ENGINEERING PLLC is a professional engineering firm founded in 2009 in the State of New York.  The company is certified by various government agencies as MBE and DBE firm. We provide engineering design, consultation and commissioning services focusing on mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection and fire alarm (MEP) systems [NAICS: 541330 and SIC: 8711]. 

Over the years, the company has performed work for both the private sector and the public sector, as subconsultant and as prime. Our largest public sector project size to date is our involvement as electrical tier sub-consultant on the PANYNJ LaGuardia Airport Central Terminal Building Replacement with an estimated budget of $3.6 Billion. Our largest private sector project size to date is our involvement as prime MEP consultant (engineer of record) for the construction of a new 975,000SF warehouse/office building at the Matrix Development Group’s Global Logistic Park in Staten Island.

Our staff consists of professionals containing the right balance of education and experience to successfully perform on most projects. We take great pride in our work and understand how its implementation will impact the lives of people. Hence, design quality is of the utmost importance in our company’s culture. We have an in-house quality assurance process whereby our work product, before final delivery, are always checked to ensure compliance with all applicable codes and standards, and that the clients project requirements are met. We are extensively familiar with federal, state, and local codes, rules and regulations including the NYC Construction Codes and various departments such as the DOB, DEP, DOH, Parks and FDNY rules, in addition to multiple standards including but not limited to the CSI, NFPA, ASHRAE, IESNA and ANSI. 

A diverse group of clients, including but not limited architects, real estate developers, building owners and managers, construction managers and procurement officials at public and private agencies alike have enjoyed the benefits of peace of mind that our involvement on their projects brings. We add value to their projects by allocating them the full attention, honesty and dedication of our experienced professionals, saving them time, money and effort conceiving the ideal solutions or design on their behalf.

We are member of the American Council of Engineering Companies (ACEC) and are fully insured.

Background
The U Rock Math tutoring program was devised to support elementary and middle school students in mathematics. Founder, Dr. Daryl Rock is a former math teacher, high school principal, and superintendent. When he left his principalship at Benjamin Banneker Academy, that school had the highest graduation rate for African American students in New York State. When students get individualized instruction and consistent time to practice in a structured, mutually respectful, learning environment, they can make substantial progress in mathematics. These are the principles that guide U Rock Math.
Overview
At each school for 100 days, 5-10 high school juniors or seniors will be hired to support 30-60 elementary or middle school students in grades 3-8. The principal will determine which students will be involved. Two 55 minute sessions will be held after school from 3-5pm Tuesday to Fridays. Tutoring will not be conducted on Mondays, but the session will be used as the prep day for tutors to prepare materials for the week and meet with teachers. Each tutor will be responsible for 3-4 students per session, all from the same class. Tutors will be recruited and interviewed beforehand and will be hired based on mathematical ability, availability, and personality. Many are bilingual. During each session, a teacher–in charge will be present, along with a college coordinator. They will supervise the program and tutor students in small groups. The college coordinator will also tutor students in small groups in addition to other duties.
